subject.title: Session bloat: skillsSnapshot and systemPromptReport accumulated on every run

question: Should OpenClaw remove full inline `systemPromptReport` from persisted session entries by splitting durable warning-dedupe state from heavyweight prompt diagnostics?
rationale: The code path is clear, but maintainers need to choose the durable semantics for warning dedupe, diagnostics, inactive-session storage, and upgrade behavior before automation changes the session state shape.

options.title: Split Compact State
options.body: Persist only the small warning/report state needed across restarts and rebuild or fetch heavyweight diagnostics on demand.

options.title: Keep Inline Report
options.body: Accept the `sessions.json` size cost until a broader database-first session migration or diagnostics redesign owns the storage shape.

options.title: Land Skills-Only Work Separately
options.body: Treat the linked PR as a partial skillsSnapshot fix and keep this issue open for the `systemPromptReport` payload.

recommendation.title: Split Compact State
recommendation.body: Persist only the small warning/report state needed across restarts and rebuild or fetch heavyweight diagnostics on demand.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the promptRef mitigation and have the strongest history signal for the session-store storage tradeoff.
